provenance: Imported from the original Hero.operationSkill and SkillBase tables by scripts/import-operations.py, replacing a four-fellow community reconstruction. Percent is skillProp_Initial/100 at skill level 1; minLevel is the AppointSkill_HeroLevel unlock, or 1 when the skill has no unlock condition. country targeting is mapped to this project business type via BuildingBase.country (1 Inspiring, 2 Diligent, 3 Brave, 4 Informed, 5 Unfettered), verified 1:1 in lib/business-data.json typeSource. Effects with neither type nor building are the original's conditionType 'all' and apply everywhere.
limits: Rarity-gated appoint skills are excluded and flagged per record, because an Everkai effect has a level gate only. Skill levels above 1 are not modelled, so skillProp_Level growth is not applied. Characters listed in content-overrides.removed are omitted.
